_note: Student concept. Figures read on the official source on the checkedAt date; not tax or legal advice.
explain: The contribution deduction has ended. If total PS savings were no more than {max} € on {endDate}, the whole balance may qualify for withdrawal in {firstWithdrawalYear} or {lastWithdrawalYear}. Normal tax still applies. Retirement age and scheduled withdrawals must be checked. The historical test is total PS savings no more than {max} € on {endDate}, not today’s balance. The whole balance may qualify for withdrawal in {firstWithdrawalYear} or {lastWithdrawalYear} without punitive tax uplift. Nordea excludes a lump sum if retirement age has already been reached and scheduled withdrawals have started. Normal tax still applies, depending on the applicable withdrawal rules and total capital income, not a guaranteed tax-free payment. Do not assume earlier contributions were deducted.
